gates.name: Open
gates.blurb: Anyone comes in. Settlers flock, and so do footpads and the foe's agents.

gates.name: Watched
gates.blurb: The watch asks every stranger their business. Turns most trouble away, puts a few settlers off, keeps two watchmen at the gate.

gates.name: Shut
gates.blurb: Nobody comes in but on the town's business. Turns nearly all trouble away, but few settlers come.
